name: claude-swap-vscode
description: Switch Claude Code accounts from the VS Code status bar, with live usage, optional background auto-switching, and separate logins per folder.

claudeSwap.executablePath.markdownDescription:
**Where the `cswap` program is.** Leave empty and Claude Swap looks for it on your PATH, in the usual `uv` and `pipx` install places, and in a trusted open folder's `.venv`.

**You will see:** nothing, when it is found. If not, the status bar shows an error with a button that opens this setting.

**Set it** if cswap lives somewhere unusual, for example `C:/tools/claude-swap/.venv/Scripts/cswap.exe`. Only your own user settings can set this; an opened project cannot, so it cannot make Claude Swap run a program of its choosing.

claudeSwap.refreshIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription:
**How often the status bar and sidebar re-read usage from cswap**, in seconds.

**You will see:** the numbers update at most this often.

**Good to know:** this does **not** get fresher numbers. cswap asks Anthropic on its own schedule, because Anthropic allows only about 30 usage checks an hour per account, so a lower value here only re-reads the same saved reading. Values under 30 are discouraged.

claudeSwap.autoSwitch.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Background auto-switch.** When on, Claude Swap checks regularly and switches the main login to a better account before the active one hits its limit — no terminal needed.

**You will see:** a notification each time it switches (see the next setting).

**Good to know:** it switches the **main login**, so every window without a separate folder login moves with it. The threshold and strategy are cswap's own settings, shared with the terminal; change them with `cswap config set autoswitch.threshold 80`.

claudeSwap.autoSwitch.intervalSeconds.markdownDescription: **How often the background auto-switch checks**, in seconds. Only matters while auto-switch is on. Only one VS Code window runs the check, however many are open.

claudeSwap.autoSwitch.notify.markdownDescription: **Tell me when auto-switch changes my account.** When off, it switches silently; the status bar still shows which account is active.

claudeSwap.warnLoginExpiryDays.markdownDescription:
**Warn this many days before a login ends.** Every Claude login lasts about 30 days, after which you must sign in again.

**You will see:** a warning once a day while a login is that close to its end — for saved accounts and for separate folder logins alike. `0` turns the warnings off.

claudeSwap.showPaceWarnings.markdownDescription:
**Warn when an account is on course to run out of its weekly quota before the week resets.**

**You will see:** at most one notification a day per account. It is a rough straight-line projection, not a promise.

claudeSwap.statusBar.showAllAccounts.markdownDescription: **Show every account in the status bar** (`#2 19% | #1 61%`) instead of only the active one. With more than four accounts it shows only the active one regardless.

claudeSwap.notifyOnReset.markdownDescription: **Tell me when every account is spent, and again when one has room.** The second message has a button that switches straight to the account with room.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Claude Swap runs the cswap executable and can change which Claude account you are logged in as. In an untrusted workspace it will not look for cswap inside the opened folder, and the executable path cannot be set by the workspace.
